calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_quarter, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26') AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9 ORDER BY 2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
web AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS control_net_sales
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT w.*, c.control_net_sales, w.web_net_sales - c.control_net_sales AS gap FROM web w JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'dup_receipt_line' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(c-1) AS extra FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_line_id', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (SELECT return_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_no_order_or_undispatched', COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND (o.web_order_id IS NULL OR o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') OR o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_not_store900_channel_WB_or_id', COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM dim_channel WHERE channel_group='web')) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'test_or_999_web_lines', COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'return_store_not900_for_web_sale', COUNT(*), SUM(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store sf ON sf.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store sr ON sr.store_key=r.store_key WHERE sf.store_id=900 AND sr.store_id<>900

SELECT d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net_in_stores, (SELECT SUM(r2.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r2 JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=r2.store_key JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=r2.return_date WHERE s2.store_id=900 AND d2.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d2.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) AS refund_net_web_booked
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store sf ON sf.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store sr ON sr.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE sf.store_id=900 AND sr.store_id<>900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
